summary_reason: Example 0 reverses standard business deal sequence (an NDA typically precedes a 基本合意, not follows it) and requires correction to maintain factual corporate accuracy.

collocations.text: 秘密保持契約を締結する
collocations.reason: Standard, high-frequency collocate in legal and corporate business.

collocations.text: 秘密保持契約を更新する
collocations.reason: Natural phrasing for renewing term-limited NDAs.

collocations.text: 秘密保持契約を解除する
collocations.reason: Legitimate legal collocate for terminating an NDA.

collocations.text: 秘密保持契約の条項を確認する
collocations.reason: Natural operational collocate during legal review.

examples.reason: In standard corporate practice, an NDA is executed prior to entering substantive talks or reaching a basic agreement (基本合意), because reaching a basic agreement requires sharing confidential information. Stating that an NDA is executed because 基本合意 was reached reverses standard business transaction sequencing.
examples.suggested_ja: 新規事業の協業に向けた具体的な協議に入るため、来週取引先と秘密保持契約を締結いたします。
examples.suggested_vi: Để bước vào thảo luận cụ thể về việc hợp tác kinh doanh mới, tuần tới chúng tôi sẽ ký kết thỏa thuận bảo mật thông tin (NDA) với đối tác.
examples.suggested_en: To enter into concrete discussions regarding new business collaboration, we will execute a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) with the partner next week.

examples.reason: Highly authentic phrasing reflecting corporate risk management and cross-departmental coordination.

dialogue.reason: Realistic corporate exchange between colleagues handling legal revision marks and contract closure.

translations.reason: Both translations are accurate and professional. (Note: Ensure NDA is capitalized in English texts).
